text: 7/8 Best practices: Use Layer 1 for big, important transfers. Use Layer 2 for daily spending and trading. Check which Layer 2 matches your wallet (Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon). Each has different speeds and costs.

author: 562a1a081967c71b
